metadata.title: Clicked like a confused toaster and somehow cooked 1 poor soul alive?! Valorant aim’s a glitch
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing like I forgot which button shoots
Enemy: probably rethinking their life choices
How did that even hit? No clue but I’ll pocket this freebie
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, welcome to the club

Tap if your aim ever surprises even you mid-chaos
